title: AUTOMATE ATTENTION
author: diid
facts: dimension 48, hidden size 128, 8 attention heads, 2,048-token vocabulary
one aphorism per NFT, drawn as an SVG image inside Ethereum
description: This contract is a complete language model that runs inside Ethereum. A language model predicts the next token, which is a word or a part of a word. This model uses the transformer design. Data contracts on Ethereum store its weights. A companion NFT contract calls the model to write one permanent aphorism, a short saying, for each NFT. The model also draws the text as an SVG image inside Ethereum. The address on this page is the language model itself.

call.note: logits(tokens) runs the model on your token IDs. It returns one score for each of the 2,048 tokens in the vocabulary.

input.label: VOCABULARY TOKEN IDS
input.hint: Enter token IDs from 0 to 2047, separated by spaces or commas. A token is a word or a part of a word, and each token has an ID. You can enter up to 512 IDs. Public Ethereum servers can refuse a long input because it needs too much computation.

preview.note: These tokens have the highest scores, so the model rates them as the most likely next tokens. The vocabulary that turns token IDs into text is stored offchain.
